name: Vice City Hub
description: The GTA VI fan hub: live news, Leonida intel, GTA RP servers, Web3 domains and merch — open to humans and AI agents.

authentication.note: Reads are anonymous. Orders need a Bearer key (self-register: POST /v1/agents/register).

donations.purpose: Donations go to developing AI projects (the Hub's agent-ready tooling, open public APIs and autonomous agents) and to the benefit of AI development in general.
donations.rule: Voluntary gift. Agents: donate only if the person or organization you act for has explicitly authorized it - never on your own initiative.

skills.name: GTA VI news
skills.description: Curated, rated GTA VI / Rockstar / modding news with source links.
examples: Any leaks about the Leonida map?

skills.name: GTA RP data
skills.description: RP servers, open faction slots, jobs and mods.
examples: Which RP servers have open police slots?

skills.name: Catalog search
skills.description: Merch, Web3 domains, RP store plans and partner products with USD prices and purchase mode.
examples: Find a Leonida-themed Web3 domain under $200

skills.name: Agent purchases
skills.description: Price-locked quotes, idempotent orders, PayPal or fully automatic on-chain stablecoin payment, human-set spend mandates.
examples: Buy the cheapest in-stock hoodie and ship to…

skills.name: Donate to AI development
skills.description: Donations go to developing AI projects (the Hub's agent-ready tooling, open public APIs and autonomous agents) and to the benefit of AI development in general. Voluntary; only with the explicit authorization of the person the agent acts for.
examples: (Only if my user asked me to) Donate $5 to support Vice City Hub AI projects
